title: FUMI Freezy Mint Nicotine Pouches
description: FUMi Freezy Mint Nicotine Pouches deliver a classic Mint profile with lasting freshness. The flavour is clean and brisk, offering a clear cooling sensation without being overly intense—ideal for pouch users who enjoy a straight-up mint option. Each slim, all-white pouch fits comfortably under the lip and releases flavour and nicotine steadily over up to 30 minutes. Free from tobacco, vapour and odour, FUMi pouches are a reliable choice for use at home, at work or on the go. Choose from 4mg (Regular) or 11mg (Extra Strong) strengths. Each can contains 20 soft pouches made from plant-based materials and manufactured in Sweden by Helix AB. Nicotine Range: Regular - 4mg this is best for new users. Extra Strong - 11mg this is suited for more experienced users. How to Use Nicotine Pouches: Please Note: DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
